solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Talks about Rod's No.1 in the hit parade

indicators.note: about means going round, so the talk word wraps the letter taken from Rod's

parts.note: talks means chats

indicators.note: No.1 means the first letter, the leading one of the word Rod's

explanation.surface: Discussion of a singer named Rod and his chart-topping single.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts R (the first letter of Rod's, signalled by 'No.1') inside CHATS.
explanation.definitionFit: The charts are the weekly rankings of best-selling records, another name for the hit parade.

clue.text: Church member beginning to leap in chaotic dancing

indicators.note: in signals that the single letter is set within the rearranged letters
dancing suggests the letters of chaotic jigging about into a new order
beginning to means the opening letter of the word leap

explanation.surface: A churchgoer starts to jump about in a wild, disorderly dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dancing' rearranges CHAOTIC; 'in' places L (first of leap, signalled by 'beginning to') among those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A Catholic belongs to the Roman Catholic Church, so is a member of that church.

clue.text: A tile initially placed in well-built floor

indicators.note: placed in says one letter is put inside the word for well-built

parts.note: well-built, as of a sturdy structure, means sound

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the word tile

explanation.surface: Laying a tile at the start of a solidly constructed floor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'floor' looks like a noun in the building scene, but it is the verb meaning to stun; 'placed in' puts T (from 'initially') inside SOUND.
explanation.definitionFit: To floor someone is to amaze or stun them, the same as to astonish.

clue.text: Custom of deportation, getting rid of old lover

indicators.note: getting rid of says the letters for the former partner are removed

parts.note: extradition is the handing over of someone to another country, a kind of deportation
an ex is a former partner

explanation.surface: A deportation practice that also disposes of someone's former partner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting rid of' takes EX from the front of EXTRADITION.
explanation.definitionFit: A tradition is a long-established custom handed down through generations.

clue.text: Selfish acts making priest go mad

indicators.note: mad suggests the letters of the two words going wild and reshuffling

explanation.surface: A priest driven crazy commits self-centred deeds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mad' rearranges PRIEST and GO together.
explanation.definitionFit: Ego trips are self-indulgent acts done to boost one's own sense of importance.

clue.text: Delegation is to change — explains the particulars

indicators.note: change signals that the letters of the preceding words are reorganised into new words

explanation.surface: A delegation must alter its stance, so it sets out the specifics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change' rearranges DELEGATION IS TO; the 'to' before it is part of the fodder, not a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To go into detail is to explain something thoroughly, covering all the particulars.

clue.text: What craftsman will need for making chair, first to last

indicators.note: first to last says the opening letter of the seat word is moved to the end

parts.note: a stool is a chair without a back

explanation.surface: Equipment a woodworker requires for building a chair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first to last' moves the S of STOOL to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Tools are the implements a craftsman works with, so they are what he needs.

clue.text: Repeat the thing time after time (wearisome ultimately)

parts.note: the thing can be it, as in 'it's the thing'
an era is a period of time
an era is a period of time

indicators.note: ultimately means the final letter of the word wearisome

explanation.surface: Saying the same thing again and again becomes tiresome in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'time after time' gives ERA and then T, the second time placed after the first.
explanation.definitionFit: To iterate is to say or do again, which is to repeat.

clue.text: Entertainer, sexual libertine ditching wife

indicators.note: ditching means dropping, so the letter for wife is discarded

parts.note: a swinger is someone sexually promiscuous, especially one who swaps partners

explanation.surface: A performer, a womaniser who has walked out on his wife.
explanation.definitionFit: A singer is a performer who sings, one kind of entertainer.

clue.text: Artist and beat girl going after the money in a group of countries

indicators.note: going after says the following pieces come behind the money word

parts.note: a cent is a coin, a unit of money
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
to lam is to beat or thrash
Erica is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A painter and a battered young woman follow the cash into a cluster of nations.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'going after' could suggest placement below; here it simply sets the money first, with the artist, beat and girl following.
explanation.definitionFit: Central America is the group of nations on the isthmus between Mexico and Colombia.

clue.text: Two heads meeting for a talk

definitions.text: Two heads meeting for a talk

parts.words: Two heads meeting for a talk
parts.note: a French phrase meaning literally head to head, used of a private chat between two people

explanation.surface: Two leaders get together to hold discussions.
explanation.definitionFit: A tete-a-tete is a private conversation between two people, literally head-to-head in French.

clue.text: Old vessel crossing eastern sea

indicators.note: crossing means stretching across, so the container word goes round the letter

parts.note: a can is a container, a vessel

explanation.surface: An aged ship sailing across the eastern waters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crossing' puts E inside CAN, after O.
explanation.definitionFit: Ocean is a word for the sea, the vast body of salt water.

clue.text: I want you to see nothing is being concealed by group

parts.note: O is nought, nothing

indicators.note: being concealed by says the small word is hidden inside the group word

parts.note: a cult is a group, such as a religious sect

explanation.surface: Someone says they have nothing hidden by their organisation, and wants to show you.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I want you to see' reads as someone showing off, but it is what an eye doctor would say of the patient.
explanation.definitionFit: An oculist is an eye specialist, whose aim is that the patient should see well.

clue.text: Establish home, say

parts.note: in means at home
to say is to state

explanation.surface: A short instruction to set up a home and declare it.
explanation.definitionFit: To instate is to install or establish someone in a position.

clue.text: Animal caught in rain, dripping

indicators.note: caught in signals that the creature is held within the following words

explanation.surface: A creature trapped in a downpour, soaking wet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'caught in' points to the run inDRI spanning rain and dripping.
explanation.definitionFit: The indri is a large lemur of Madagascar, an animal.

clue.text: After endless criticism he had to get married

indicators.note: endless means the last letter of the criticism word is cut off

parts.note: an attack is harsh criticism
he'd is the contraction of he had

explanation.surface: Having stopped his nagging, the man went off to wed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' drops K from ATTACK; HED is he'd without its apostrophe.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone attached is in a committed relationship, here meaning wed.

clue.text: Tower in settlement north of a river

indicators.note: north of in a down clue means placed above, so the settlement word comes first

parts.note: a camp is a temporary settlement
the Nile is the great African river

explanation.surface: A tower in a village on high ground overlooking a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A campanile is a bell tower, usually standing apart from its church.

clue.text: Think about opposing team and run

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
a side is a team
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Weighing up the rival players and a dash.
explanation.definitionFit: To consider is to think something over carefully.

clue.text: Normal flag

definitions.meaning: a banner, especially one carried as an emblem

explanation.definitionFit: Standard means usual or normal, and a standard is also a flag or banner.

clue.text: Uttering a short story before the monarch

indicators.note: before says the cut word comes ahead of the ruler word
short means the story word loses its last letter

parts.note: a tale is a story
a king is a monarch

explanation.surface: Telling a brief tale to the sovereign.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' trims TALE to TAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Talking is speaking, the act of uttering words.

clue.text: A few special words to put at end of test

indicators.note: put at end of says the small word goes after the test word

parts.note: the MOT is the annual British roadworthiness test for vehicles

explanation.surface: Some choice words to place at the close of an exam.
explanation.walkthrough: The MOT is the yearly safety check required for British cars.
explanation.definitionFit: A motto is a short phrase expressing a guiding principle, a few special words.

clue.text: New Jersey city apartment — rent one not wholly visible

indicators.note: not wholly visible means the city is partly concealed in the words that follow

explanation.surface: A flat in an American city that is only partly seen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not wholly visible' points to the run apartmenT RENT ONe.
explanation.definitionFit: Trenton is the state capital of New Jersey.

clue.text: A father overlooks your lack of concern

indicators.note: overlooks in a down clue means sits above, so the father word goes over the other

parts.note: pa is father
thy is an old form of your

explanation.surface: A dad ignores your indifference.
explanation.definitionFit: Apathy is a lack of interest, enthusiasm or concern.

clue.text: Range of colours displayed by little female friend you fancy?

parts.note: pal means friend
the suffix -ette marks something small or feminine, as in kitchenette or usherette

explanation.surface: A selection of shades shown by a small girlfriend you are attracted to.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the whimsical reading of the answer as a little female pal.
explanation.definitionFit: A palette is the range of colours an artist uses or that a design employs.

clue.text: Report of sorrowful manifestations in rows

indicators.note: report of signals a word that sounds the same as the next phrase

parts.note: tears are the outward signs of sorrow

explanation.surface: An account of weeping displayed in lines.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiers are rows or levels placed one above another.

clue.text: A steer's breaking lose, presenting problems

indicators.note: breaking lose suggests the letters breaking free and rearranging

explanation.surface: A bullock escaping causes difficulties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaking lose' rearranges ASTEERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Teasers are tricky puzzles or problems, as in brain-teasers.

clue.text: Wind brings sharp pain — not good

indicators.note: not means without, so the letter for good is left out

parts.note: a twinge is a sudden sharp pain

explanation.surface: Flatulence causes a stab of pain, which is unpleasant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wind' looks like a gust or gas, but it is the verb meaning to coil, pronounced to rhyme with find.
explanation.definitionFit: To twine is to wind or twist something round.

clue.text: Introduced new dietitian

indicators.note: new suggests the letters of dietitian are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A recently qualified nutritionist is presented.
explanation.definitionFit: To be initiated is to be introduced to something, or admitted into a group.

clue.text: Old European woman thus accompanying bloke to the west

indicators.note: to the west in an across clue means read leftwards, backwards

parts.note: Val is a woman's name
so means thus
a guy is a bloke

explanation.surface: A woman goes with a man heading westwards, a European from a vanished country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to the west' reverses VALSOGUY in full.
explanation.definitionFit: A Yugoslav was a citizen of Yugoslavia, a European country that no longer exists.

clue.text: What student losing bit in the middle becomes

definitions.text: What student losing bit in the middle becomes

indicators.note: losing bit in the middle says the centre letter of the student word is dropped

parts.note: a learner is a student

explanation.surface: A pupil who slims round the waist ends up thinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing bit in the middle' drops R, the central letter of LEARNER; the whole clue also describes someone slimmer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who loses weight round the middle becomes thinner, that is more lean.
